title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Music Hall on 1972-09-16
lineage: mixed source (AUD>MC>) and (SBD>MR>) C> D> CD> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Composite matrix recording with moments of great sound but overall mixed audio quality
ai_review.review: The recording is a composite of soundboard and audience sources; one reviewer hails it as one of the best from ’70‑’72, while another calls the audience portion sub‑par. The mix delivers occasional clarity but suffers from uneven audience bleed, leading to a mixed listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews with divergent opinions – a strong positive (4★) about overall sound, a negative (2★) focusing on the audience component, and a neutral request for release. The lack of performance details limits confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: First reviewer praises crisp, great‑sounding mix; third reviewer notes subpar audience recording quality and overall unevenness.
